Consumo Defensivo.titulo: It Wasn’t a Strait of Hormuz Relief Rally, After All
Consumo Defensivo.descripcion: Why didn’t anything but tech rally on Monday after the U.S. and Iran announced an agreement that would reopen the Strait of Hormuz?  Peter Boockvar, chief investment officer of One Point BFG Wealth Partners, notes that if the market was reacting to the news and lower oil prices, more of the stocks that are exposed to both would have rallied.  Walmart, Costco, and Target were among the stocks that were down despite the prospect of lower gas prices.
